reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment — consistent with the expectation that compliant findings carry no edit or negotiation ask.

The cited text supports the conclusion: Section 4.5.1 gives AbbVie (our party) the sole right, not an obligation, to Manufacture and supply commercial product, so there is no obligation to purchase volumes from Harpoon.

Sections 6.1–6.3 impose event-based (upfront/milestone) and sales-based (royalty) consideration, not fees for unpurchased volume, so no take-or-pay, shortfall or minimum-volume construct binds us — this meets the MINCOMMIT preferred position.

Rationale appropriately notes the only 'minimum' hits are mutual insurance limits and the 'purchase' hit is a Distributor definitional carve-out, and correctly declines to double-flag diligence/milestone terms handled under other rules.
No deterministic check failures; retaining this as internal compliance evidence rather than a negotiation issue is correct.
